_note: Cinematic mood layers v1 (Oct 23, 2026; Gary approved the EASY set only at 11:31 AM CT): per-area colour tint, soft vignette, ambient particles, sun rays through cloud gaps. NOT approved (never add here): blurred foreground framing, lens flares, fog, camera zooms. Read by src/overworld/mood.js. Coder-owned: map files stay World Design's. A map preset extends one of `defaults` (outdoor | indoor | cave; picked by clock.js INDOOR_OR_CAVE when `extends` is missing) and may list `areas` (tile rects [x, y, w, h], first match wins) that override it. Every number is a CAP checked by tests/mood.test.mjs: tint alpha <= 0.2, vignette alpha <= 0.45, ray alpha <= 0.2.

_fields.tint: {color, alpha (a flat source-over wash, baked with the vignette into one cached native-res layer: no full-screen blend op, cheap on phones), phases: {dawn, day, dusk, night} strength 0..1}. Scaled by the scene grade name (indoors = day); night is 0 everywhere so the night grade/LUT look stays as is.
_fields.vignette: {color, alpha (corner darkness), inner (0..1 radius where it starts), phases}. Native-res, cached; one drawImage per frame.
_fields.particles: [{kind: motes | dust | fireflies | leaves | snow | embers, density (per 480x270 native px view), phases: [..] (missing = all)}]. Off under reduced motion and in rain. Profile mood.particles scales the count, mood.maxParticles caps it.
_fields.rays: {color, alpha, minCoverage (cloud coverage 0..1), length, width} or false. Outdoor + day/dawn/dusk only, strength = living.js cloudLevel (stepped 1/8, 0 at night), anchored on clear holes in the cloud mask so they drift with the cloud shadows.

brookhollow._why: Home village: warm afternoon gold, light vignette, sunlit dust; fireflies at dusk/night by the river.

route1._why: Sunmeadow Fields: the brightest, most open grade (pollen-gold), the most motes; rays read best over the open grass.

route1_storm._why: Storm variant of Route 1 (region_pulls R1): grey-cool, heavier vignette, no motes or rays (rain is handled by living.js wet too).

fernwick._why: Woodland town by the pond: green-gold canopy light, falling leaves by day, fireflies on the pond bank at dusk/night.

fernwick_hall_int._why: Master 1's hall: warm lamp-lit wood, a stronger vignette to frame the arena, slow dust.

greystone_entrance._why: Cave mouth: cool blue, deep corners, drifting dust.

greystone_b1._why: Greystone B1 (Gary named it with region 1): the coolest, darkest-framed grade; crystal-violet hint in the tint.

thornwood._why: Forest (next to region 1, not in Gary's list; data only): deep green, leaves, fireflies in the glades.

frostspire._why: Snow only where it fits (later region; data only, not reviewed).
